children: CXJ GROUP CO., Ltd reported full-year 2026 revenue of $531606 up 16% from $458632 a year earlier, while net loss attributable to the company narrowed to $(9,680) from a loss of $(2,284,025) in FY 2025.
Revenue was $531,606 for FY 2026, compared with $458,632 in FY 2025; YoY change 16.0%.
Net income was a loss of $(9,680) for FY 2026, compared with a loss of $(2,284,025) in FY 2025 (loss narrowed).
Total revenue growth of 16% was driven by higher automotive product sales despite a decline in brand management fees.
Sales mix shifted toward motor oil, fuel additive and exhaust cleaner products, which increased product revenue.
Declining brand management fees reduced margin contribution and increased reliance on product sales for growth.
Operating expenses fell sharply after the prior-year goodwill impairment and one-time consultancy/legal write-offs.
Operating cash improved materially, supported by increased contract liabilities and better collections.
